name: manual_cb77c6
claim: Cross-repository security contracts must state only enforceable platform guarantees, link every remediation commit, and update the companion ADR whenever review changes the implementation's actual failure mode.

decisions.notes: The first ADR overclaimed HTTPS scope and portable race safety. It now requires HTTPS for every configured endpoint, scopes late-symlink guarantees to POSIX descriptor operations, labels the portable guard best-effort, and records the final PT evidence.
